subject: Implementation milestone commitments & risk register for Brightline pilot
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP & proposed delivery dates for Brightline pilot

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that breaks the pilot into 5 milestones with owner recommendations and target dates. High-level ask: please review the milestones below and confirm whether the target dates align with Brightline procurement and security windows.

Draft milestones (high level) — please confirm owners/dates:
- M1: Kickoff + environment access provided — target: 2026-11-29 (owner: Brightline IT)
- M2: Test corpus & prompt set defined — target: 2026-12-06 (owner: Brightline Product)
- M3: Integration + initial validation (API + security review) — target: 2026-12-20 (owner: Redwood SE)
- M4: Pilot validation + quality review — target: 2027-01-10 (owner: Brightline Product / CS)
- M5: Go/no-go + PO issuance for Q1 expansion — target: 2027-01-24 (owner: Brightline Procurement)

Risks called out in the draft MAP: SOC2 evidence turnaround, VPC peering windows, and procurement PO timing. I included a short risk register and mitigation options in the attached MAP stub (Brightline_MAP_v1.pdf).

If the kickoff week of Nov 29 works I’ll schedule the internal kickoff and loop in our implementation lead, Olga. Marissa will own the integration plan and test harness. Tessa (cc’d on future threads) will coordinate contract steps.

Next actions: can you confirm the kickoff window and whether your procurement team has a standard PO lead time? Also flag any compliance evidence we should pre-attach (SOC2 snapshot, diagram, audit contact).

Thanks —
Rishi
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Brightline_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft, 3 pages)

From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightline Procure <procure@brightlinehealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed delivery dates for Brightline pilot

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear draft. A few notes from our side after internal alignment:
1) Kickoff: Nov 29 works for our team (we prefer early morning PST).
2) Procurement timeline: we typically take 2–3 weeks turnaround for a standard PO once the SOW is agreed. Target for PO issuance will likely be week of Jan 24 as you suggested, but we can try to accelerate if the SOW is simple.
3) Compliance: we need a SOC2 snapshot and contact for audits; can you share the latest SOC2 artifact? Also confirm whether the pilot will involve storing any PHI — it will not.
4) Integration: our Product team will own test corpus and will need a sample of the integration test harness by Dec 6.

I looped in Procure (cc) — they’ll confirm the PO timing and contract review SLA separately.

If you can update the MAP with a short note on who from Redwood will be the day-to-day technical contact, we’ll mark internal owners and confirm on Friday.

Thanks,
Laura Kim
Head of Product
Brightline Health

Forwarded attachment references: (no files attached in this reply)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & proposed delivery dates for Brightline pilot

Team —

Copying Laura’s notes below for quick context (see her message above). I took a pass editing the MAP draft and converted the risk register into an action-oriented table (attached). High level responsibilities I propose:
- CS lead (Rishi): stakeholder cadence and go/no-go decision authority
- Implementation lead (Olga): environment setup, network coordination, peering, and security checklist
- SE (Marissa): API integration, test harness delivery, validation scripts
- Sales (Tessa): contract/terms, PO/discount coordination, escalation to legal if redlines appear

Top risk items and mitigation owners (summary):
- SOC2 evidence delay — mitigation: attach SOC2 snapshot and provide security contact (owner: Olga)
- VPC peering window — mitigation: Redwood to provide peering template + network runbook; request access by Nov 22 (owner: Olga / Marissa)
- Procurement timing — mitigation: Tessa to provide SOW stub and proposed T&C earlier this week to compress review

I attached: Brightline_MAP_v1.pdf and Risk_Register_Brightline_v1.xlsx (stub). I will start drafting environment access checklist and will reach out to Brightline IT to get the firewall rules and IP allowlist.

I’ll own the SOC2 snapshot delivery (expecting to share the artifact by 2026-11-06).

Olga
Principal Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_v1.pdf (updated 2 pages), Risk_Register_Brightline_v1.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@brightlinehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed delivery dates for Brightline pilot

Laura / team —

Thanks, this all sounds good. Procurement note: to speed PO issuance we can provide a limited-scope SOW and an estimate for the pilot that matches M1–M4 deliverables; legal redlines typically add 7–10 business days. I’m attaching a SOW stub and a DocuSign placeholder link so Procure can preview contract language early.

Proposed next actions from Sales:
- I’ll send SOW stub (SOW_Brightline_Stub.docx) to Procure this week
- If procurement needs a credit/checklist for early access we can offer a 30-day invoice net instead of requiring PO up front for the pilot (needs sales manager approval).

Please confirm whether Brightline needs invoicing constraints up front or if Procure is fine with standard PO timing.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOW_Brightline_Stub.docx, DocuSign preview link

From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed delivery dates for Brightline pilot

Team —

Quick update from Procure: we can accept the limited-scope SOW and expect to route the PO for signature by 2027-01-24. I’ve attached a signed SOW stub (SOW_Brightline_Signed.pdf) with our standard PO clauses.

Confirming:
- Kickoff: Nov 29 — 09:30 PST (Brightline Product + IT + Redwood)
- SOC2: please send the snapshot and security contact (Olga) by Nov 6 as noted so we can start our security intake
- Test harness: Product to receive integration sample by Dec 6

We don’t expect PHI in the pilot and will proceed under our standard data handling. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Laura Kim
Head of Product
Brightline Health

Attachment: SOW_Brightline_Signed.pdf (signed stub), SOC2_request_form.xlsx (procurement request form)
